activity_hint: Progress for crawls, dedup, tagging and other jobs shows up here as it happens.
api_error_read_failed: Failed to read the service response
api_error_too_large: The service response exceeds the size limit
atlas_gate_ready: DINOv2 is installed. Generate the map again.
atlas_hint_over: {cluster} holds {share}% of the set and may make the LoRA overfit to it.
atlas_keep_hint: Keep {keep}, remove {drop} (red rings). Decisions only; files are untouched.
atlas_keep_unavailable: This run returned no vectors, so the most diverse images can't be picked.
atlas_key_hints: V pan · L lasso · Shift-drag adds a lasso · wheel zooms; thumbnails appear when zoomed in
atlas_key_select_all: Select all images on the map
atlas_none_body: Embeds the tag-stage images with DINOv2, then reduces and clusters them into a map you can lasso. Removing on the map records decisions only; files are untouched.
atlas_removed_toast: Removed {count} from the tag input · decisions only, files untouched
atlas_restore_partial: Restored {count}; the other {rest} were excluded by another stage and were left alone
atlas_stage_label: Semantic map canvas: wheel zooms, drag pans, Shift-drag lassos
atlas_stale: The dataset changed ({added} added, {changed} changed); the map may be out of date.
atlas_tag_help: Separate tags with commas. Uses the same batch endpoint as the Tag studio: preview first, then write.
atlas_tag_stats: {changed} will get the tags, {unchanged} already have them
atlas_unavailable_dedup_disabled: Dedup is turned off, so the semantic map can't be generated.
atlas_unavailable_python_missing: The dedup Python environment wasn't found, so the semantic map can't be generated.
atlas_unavailable_worker_missing: The semantic map worker wasn't found, so the map can't be generated.
boot_backend_start_failed: The backend process could not start
boot_backend_start_timeout: Timed out waiting for the backend to start
boot_host_failed: The desktop host reported an error
boot_platform_unavailable: The desktop host is temporarily unavailable
boot_runtime_unavailable: Cannot read the local service address
boot_unhealthy: The local service failed its health check
captions_conflicts: {count} changed before writing and were skipped
captions_undo_partial: Restored {restored}; {skipped} were edited since and left as is
clean_batch_hint: {count} per batch: number keys toggle keep, Enter applies the batch.
clean_character_unavailable: The character filter needs reference images; this dataset has no images to pick from yet.
clean_idle_body: Analyzes every image and flags monochrome, sketch, or off-character ones. Flags are suggestions: nothing is dropped until you confirm each batch, and dropping never deletes files.
clean_need_references: Pick reference images for the character filter.
clean_none_body: This run flagged nothing, so you can go straight to dedup.
clean_none_reason: No images flagged for this reason.
clean_references_hint: Pick images from the dataset that represent the character, up to {max}.
clean_references_more: Showing the first page only; search file names to narrow it down.
clean_rerun_body: Re-running replaces the current flags; decisions you already applied stay in the funnel.
collect_crawl_hint: Search a few sites for artists, tags and other addresses, then submit the ones you pick as one crawl batch.
collect_crawl_idle: Enter a keyword, pick sites, then search.
collect_crawl_note: When the batch finishes it is attached to this dataset as a source
collect_crawl_searching: Searching, this can take a while…
collect_empty_hint: Add images from a local folder, a library directory or an online crawl. Sources are references; files are not copied or moved.
collect_library_empty: The library has no sources yet.
collect_library_hint: Pick a source, or open one of its subdirectories to add only part of it.
collect_no_members: No images yet. They appear here once newly added folders finish scanning.
collect_path_hint: There is no system folder picker in browser mode; enter the folder's absolute path.
collect_remove_hint: Its {count} images leave the dataset; the files themselves are not deleted.
crawl_addresses_truncated: Too many addresses; only the first ones are listed.
crawl_task_none: Select a task to see its log.
crawl_tasks_empty: This batch has no tasks yet.
dataset_create_hint: You can change the name and trigger word later.
dataset_delete_hint: Only the dataset, its decisions and run history are deleted; library images and files are untouched.
dataset_field_trigger_hint: Prepended to every caption when tagging.
dataset_not_found: This dataset does not exist; it may have been deleted.
dedup_auto_hint: Exact and compression-only duplicates already keep one image automatically. If one was wrong, restore the dropped image.
dedup_hint_zoom: Wheel zooms all · drag pans · 0 resets
dedup_idle_body: Finds exact, compression-only, and look-alike images. Exact ones keep one automatically; look-alikes are compared group by group. Dropping never deletes files.
dedup_none_body: No groups need manual comparison; {count} were handled automatically.
dedup_run_basic_only: Similarity models aren’t installed, so this run only finds exact and compression duplicates.
dedup_run_similarity: Finds exact, compression, and look-alike duplicates.
diag_overall_warning: Required components are healthy; some optional ones need attention
diag_summary_language: Component notes come from the backend and are in Chinese for now.
downloads_error_mirror_invalid: The mirror must be an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query or fragment
downloads_error_proxy_invalid: The proxy must be an HTTP(S) address with a port
downloads_error_proxy_required: Enter a proxy address for the custom mode
downloads_hint: Models download from Hugging Face; these settings apply to every install.
downloads_proxy_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved proxy
downloads_proxy_pool_hint: Each download leases a node from the proxy pool and returns it afterwards.
downloads_token_hint: Write-only: never shown again after saving, only the last four characters. Used for models that require sign-in.
export_blocker_source_offline: {count} images come from an offline source; relink it in the library first.
export_error_interrupted: The backend restarted and interrupted the export.
export_issue_repeats_invalid: Repeats must be a whole number from 1 to 10000.
export_issue_trigger_required: The kohya layout needs a trigger word.
export_layout_flat_hint: All images and captions go into one folder named after the dataset.
export_layout_kohya_hint: The folder is named repeats_trigger (e.g. 10_alice), which kohya / sd-scripts read directly.
export_plan_collisions: {count} name clashes will get a suffix.
export_plan_hint: Fill in the options and preview the plan to see which files will be written; previewing writes nothing.
export_plan_stale: Options changed; preview again before starting.
export_plan_target_exists: {name} already exists in the target folder; pick another folder or name.
export_resume_hint: Resuming skips files that were already copied.
export_reveal_failed: Couldn’t open the file manager; the folder may have moved.
export_target_pick_failed: Couldn’t open the folder picker; paste the path instead.
gfx_reason_context_lost: The WebGL context was lost; using Canvas2D
gfx_reason_init_failed: WebGL2 failed to start; using Canvas2D
gfx_saved_hint: Saved on this device; other canvas views use the same choice.
gfx_subtitle: {count} sprites drawn with WebGL2 or Canvas2D
grid_key_jump: Jump to start, end or by page
home_empty_hint: A dataset gathers images from your library and folders into one training set: collect, clean, dedup, tag, review, then export.
jobs_live_hint: Crawls, dedup, tagging and other jobs show up here once they start; recently finished ones stay for a while.
keys_escape: Close, clear the selection or go up a level
library_add_hint: Attaches the whole folder “{name}” (with subfolders) to a dataset. Datasets reference the library by folder, not by single image; images added to the folder later join the dataset too.
library_empty_hint: Add a local folder and the library scans its images and matching TXT files. Online crawl batches show up here as well.
library_import_hint: Browser mode has no system folder picker. Enter the folder's absolute path.
library_no_assets_here: No images at this level. Open a subfolder above.
library_offline_banner: Source offline: its root folder is gone (moved, renamed or the disk is not mounted).
library_relink_hint: Pick the new root folder. The library matches images by relative path, then rescans.
library_remove_files: Also delete the files on disk (cannot be undone)
library_remove_hint: The library stops listing this source and datasets that reference it lose these images. Files on disk are kept by default.
library_rename_extension: Leave out the extension; it stays the same
library_rename_hint: Changes the base name only; the extension stays and a matching TXT is renamed too.
library_rename_invalid: No / \ : * ? " < > | or control characters, and no trailing dot
library_rename_too_long: Name too long (255 characters at most)
library_trash_purge_hint: The files are deleted from disk and cannot be recovered.
library_trash_restored: Restored {count} items to their original place
library_trash_subtitle: Grouped by each move; restore puts files back where they were
library_txt_conflict: The TXT changed elsewhere and was reloaded. Edit it again.
library_txt_invalid_encoding: The TXT is not UTF-8 and cannot be edited here
library_txt_missing: No matching TXT; saving creates one
library_txt_pair_conflict: Several matching TXT files; cannot edit here
models_gate_body: This step needs the models below and continues once they are installed.
models_license_body: These models use custom licenses. Continuing means you have read and accept them.
models_subtitle: Local models used by dedup, atlas, cleaning and tagging
network_account_browser: Sign in in the project browser
network_account_busy: The authorization browser is in use by another site
network_account_clear_body: Saved cookies or tokens are deleted; you will need to sign in again.
network_account_waiting: Waiting for sign-in in the browser…
network_accounts_resetting: Clearing the authorization browser data; authorization is paused.
network_input_not_http: Needs an HTTP(S) URL with a host
network_input_too_many: At most 512 nodes at a time
network_policy_default_hint: Used by sites without an override
network_policy_reset_body: Removes this site's override; new tasks use the default policy.
network_policy_unknown: {count} override(s) for unsupported sites are ignored.
network_proxy_leased: {leases} task(s) are using the pool; start, stop and reload are paused.
network_proxy_reload_required: Sources changed; reload to apply them.
network_source_remove_body: Reload the proxy pool afterwards to apply the change.
network_sources_inline_hint: One per line: http, socks5, ss, vless, vmess, trojan, hysteria2 and more.
network_sources_node_file_placeholder: Local path of the node file
network_sources_readonly: Sources come from the config file and cannot be edited here.
network_sources_readonly_legacy: The backend returned the legacy shape; shown read-only.
network_sources_reset_body: Removes the subscriptions, node file and manual nodes saved here and goes back to the config file. Takes effect after a reload.
network_sources_truncated: Too many sources; only part of them is shown.
network_subtitle: Proxy pool, site accounts and crawl policies
page_datasets_hint: Create a dataset, then move it through collect → clean → dedup → tag → review → export.
page_placeholder: This page arrives in a later phase.
prefs_motion_hint_off: Transitions always play, whatever the system says.
prefs_motion_hint_on: Transitions and animations are always off, whatever the system says.
prefs_motion_hint_system_full: The system does not ask for reduced motion, so transitions play normally.
prefs_motion_hint_system_reduced: The system asks for reduced motion, so transitions and animations are off.
prefs_renderer_hint: Auto uses WebGL2 when it is hardware accelerated, and Canvas2D otherwise or after a lost WebGL context.
prefs_subtitle: Stored on this machine and applied immediately
tag_estimate_hint: Merge mode needs the tags the last tagging run wrote, which aren't known here, so existing tags count as hand-added. The write preview is exact.
tag_mode_fill_empty_hint: Only write images without a caption; leave the rest alone.
tag_mode_merge_hint: Keep hand-added tags and replace what the last tagging run wrote.
tag_mode_overwrite_hint: Replace existing captions with the tagger output (the trigger word stays).
tag_no_changes: Writing with these thresholds would not change any caption.
tag_pick_model: Pick a tagger model to start.
tag_scores_missing: {count} of {total} images have no tagger scores yet
tag_scores_ready: All {count} images have scores; drag a threshold to preview
tag_skipped: {count} have no scores or a caption that can't be written and will be skipped
tag_write_hint: Writes review-stage captions with these settings. You can undo it afterwards.
triage_expired: The dataset changed and this run expired; run it again.
triage_failed_assets: {count} images weren’t saved; try again later.
triage_min_keep: Keep at least one per group.
triage_running_hint: You can leave this page; analysis continues in the background.
triage_undo_not_latest: Only the latest change can be undone.
viewer_stage: Image canvas: scroll to zoom, drag to pan, double-click to reset
